generations.name: metricsByItemOperationAndDay
generations.table: Metrics By Item Operation And Day

queries.capacitySummary:
DEFINE
  VAR __Window = FILTER('Metrics By Item Operation And Day', 'Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Timepoint] >= @Start && 'Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Timepoint] < @End)
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
  __Window[Capacity Id],
  __Window[Capacity Name],
  __Window[SKU],
  __Window[Capacity Units],
  __Window[Region],
  __Window[Capacity State],
  __Window[State Reason],
  "__TotalCuSeconds", SUM(__Window[CU (s)]),
  "__StorageBytes", SUM(__Window[Storage Bytes]),
  "__ObservedAt", MAX(__Window[Timepoint]),
  "__MeanUtilizationPercent", AVERAGE(__Window[Interactive Billable %]),
  "__PeakUtilizationPercent", MAX(__Window[Interactive Billable %]),
  "__WorkspaceCount", DISTINCTCOUNT(__Window[Workspace Id]),
  "__ItemCount", DISTINCTCOUNT(__Window[Item Id]),
  "__InteractiveDelayPercent", MAX(__Window[Interactive Delay %]),
  "__InteractiveRejectionPercent", MAX(__Window[Interactive Rejection %]),
  "__BackgroundRejectionPercent", MAX(__Window[Background Rejection %]),
  "__CumulativeCarryOverPercent", MAX(__Window[Cumulative Carryover %]),
  "__ExpectedBurndownMinutes", MAX(__Window[Expected Burndown (min)]),
  "__SurgeProtectionActive", MAX(__Window[Surge Protection Active])
)
ORDER BY __Window[Capacity Id]
